summary.name: Particle Art
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: subjects are formed from particle density, size, brightness, and color against a contrasting background. Selected trails may indicate direction. Particles coordinate into poses, flows, and structural changes, holding stable silhouettes at key moments. Glow must not erase detail.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: abstract brand moments and transformations between silhouettes. Inferred from good-fit list: psychedelic or demoscene imagery, infinite-zoom transitions, and surreal or abstract spatial passages. Hybrids suit cases where particles must carry legible meaning.
summary.limitations: Explicit: particles alone cannot carry precise data or legible words, so a support style is needed. Glow must not erase detail. Poor fits include dense text during travel, unplanned hidden resets, and topics needing stable orientation or reduced motion. Simulated appearance is not validated physics.
summary.palette: Authored suggestion, used only when no task, brand, or reference palette is supplied: background #111C29, foreground #EFF5EE, accent_1 #65BEC2, accent_2 #CEAF79. Gradients are disabled. Foreground on background measures 15.521:1; dark text on accent_1 measures 7.936:1 and on accent_2 8.21:1. Verify composited frames; do not recolor assets.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: point positions and brightness animate in shaders with controlled blending and selective bloom, driven by shared seekable time. Interactive hover or scroll applies only to interactive delivery, not video. Optional motion references (vortex transit, helix flow, orbit, chaptered transition, orb morph, storytelling) are used only if their subject and geometry fit; choosing none is valid.
summary.audio: Unspecified: the source sets no audio requirement and mandates no audio layer. Proposed choices (music, voiceover, sung vocals, effects, ambience, or silence) are inferred from topic and objective. Honor explicit user audio choices first. Keep speech intelligible, avoid competing vocals, and source only authorized assets.
summary.assetRequirements: Unspecified for specific files. Required in practice: fixed seeded point samples, target poses, and colors, with fonts and assets loaded before rendering. Helix flow needs prepared views or geometry. Orbit needs a complete 3D subject or sufficient turntable views. Hybrid diagrams or cards need exported SVG or raster assets.
summary.combinations: Explicit: style-097 adds data mapping, where particle counts match stated data units, with bloom limited to clusters and never covering labels. style-093 adds title typography: particles converge toward glyphs, while final legible text is real DOM or SVG type held for reading time. Long sentences rendered as particles should be avoided.
summary.productionApproach: Explicit: Three.js (Scene, WebGLRenderer, ShaderMaterial, Points, BufferGeometry) and GLSL own visual construction and motion. HyperFrames is the primary pipeline for assembly, timing, sync, checks, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and that reason must be recorded. chroma.js is optional for palette validation.
